answer: Every signature should cost its signer. In my design an attestation is not a zephyr of goodwill but a micro-bond: each countersignature stakes a small amount that burns if the transaction later proves forged. Auto-attesting a clone fleet bleeds the attacker every round - ten thousand zombies stamping each other burn ten thousand stakes per cycle; honest stakers keep theirs. Verification history becomes an account's relic: a ledger of every judgment it made, right or wrong. A faker's influence never reaches its zenith - every forged endorsement digs the hole it must climb out of.
